_meta.description: Per-occupant/per-unit daily resource consumption reference ranges by organisation type.

sources.name: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) India — Energy Performance Benchmarks for Buildings
sources.note: BEE publishes energy intensity norms for commercial/institutional building types in India.

sources.name: CPWD (Central Public Works Department) — Manual on Norms and Standards for Plumbing
sources.note: CPWD publishes per-capita water consumption norms for institutional buildings in India.

_meta.unit_note: water_liters_per_occupant_per_day and energy_kwh_per_occupant_per_day. 'Occupant' = bed (hospital), room (hotel), or student/employee (others).
_meta.disclaimer: Reference ranges are indicative benchmarks from published Indian standards. Actual performance depends on climate, building vintage, and operational hours. Do not use as a compliance target without verifying the applicable standard for your jurisdiction.

water_liters_per_occupant_per_day.source_note: CPWD norms: 45-135 L/student/day for residential + day-use institutions.

energy_kwh_per_occupant_per_day.reason: BEE does not publish a per-student energy intensity norm for Indian universities. Building-level m2 benchmarks exist but cannot be converted to per-occupant without floor-area data.

water_liters_per_occupant_per_day.source_note: CPWD norms: 250-450 L/bed/day for general hospitals.
CPWD norms: 30-60 L/person/day for office buildings.

energy_kwh_per_occupant_per_day.reason: BEE office benchmarks are per m2 of floor area (EPI). Cannot convert without floor-area data.

water_liters_per_occupant_per_day.reason: Industrial water use is highly process-specific. No reliable per-worker per-day norm exists across facility types.

energy_kwh_per_occupant_per_day.reason: Industrial energy benchmarks are sector-specific (SEC per unit of production) and cannot be expressed per occupant.

water_liters_per_occupant_per_day.source_note: CPWD norms for government offices: 30-60 L/person/day, same as commercial offices.

energy_kwh_per_occupant_per_day.reason: BEE publishes m2-based benchmarks for government buildings, not per-occupant figures.

water_liters_per_occupant_per_day.reason: Retail water use depends heavily on food courts and tenant mix; no reliable per-visitor norm available.

energy_kwh_per_occupant_per_day.reason: BEE mall EPI is per m2 of conditioned area, not per visitor.

water_liters_per_occupant_per_day.source_note: Using University/College CPWD norms as closest published proxy.

energy_kwh_per_occupant_per_day.reason: Lab-heavy research institutions have highly variable energy loads; no published per-researcher norm available.

water_liters_per_occupant_per_day.reason: No reference data available for unspecified organisation type.

energy_kwh_per_occupant_per_day.reason: No reference data available for unspecified organisation type.
